title: Green Tree Golf Course

services.name: Foot Golf
services.desc: Think golf meets soccer. Foot Golf is a fun, new sport that is easy to play, and something all ages can enjoy. Foot Golf originated in the Netherlands and has spread over 16 countries throughout the world. Similar to Golf, rules and etiquette remain the same. For game play, the players’ intent is to kick a ball into the hole with the least amount of strokes possible. Foot Golf uses the basic model of Golf, with a tee box, greens, bunkers, hazards, and 18 holes of play. Also, there is par for every hole, mimicking Golf scorecard’s, and can play up to a foursome. blurb: Welcome to Green Tree Golf Club, a public golf course in Victorville, California offering affordable, fun golf in the High Desert. Designed by William F. Bell, ASGCA, the par-72 Green Tree Golf Course opened in October 1963 and remains a welcoming place for local golfers, visiting players, families, outing groups, and anyone looking for an enjoyable round of golf.
